decisions: Preserve the exact 0.3.1 control manifests and SDK 1.32.2; pin 0.3.3 candidate without production deployment.
Refuse actual upstream execution outside explicit fresh GitHub-hosted Linux/Windows Node 24 context. Separate lane homes/state/cache and validate directory ownership. Guard is not an OS sandbox.

Use real SDK through the unchanged managed stdio gateway; verify all 53 tool contracts, actual returned configuration, owned file/search/process/PDF behavior, exact read-only denial, admission release and EOF cleanup.

Use npm ci with lifecycle scripts disabled. Both locks contain ripgrep1.18.0 prebuilt optional packages; remove the unnecessary rebuild, verify the exact native binary version/hash/path, and disclose npm/Chrome networking.
Restore all 16 unrelated native libc selectors dropped by npm lock regeneration. All other existing unrelated lock entries remain identical.
Independent review identified three false-positive proof weaknesses. Add actual failing counterexamples before tightening blocklist, configuration and output-tail assertions.
Canonicalize ordinary temporary path aliases after rejecting every actual link/junction ancestor, retaining source/store separation and pinned ownership.
Record bounded search state/count observations and specific assertion codes to diagnose the failed hosted comparison without exposing arbitrary response content.
Count published UUID.json heartbeat records rather than concurrent atomic-write temporary files in the existing shared-admission fixture and new probe.

Validate the published MCP text-only search, command denial and process-start responses; both pinned upstream versions deliberately strip internal structured facts for these handlers. Do not bypass the public gateway boundary.

Bind every search row to one of six owned files and exact matched text; require clean completed status, consistent total counts, complete bounded pages, correct more flags and disjoint full file coverage. Permit singular running results.
Replace the existing pause test sleep with explicit started, queued and release barriers after a hosted timing failure; no production admission behavior changes.

After both Linux lanes failed PDF creation while both Windows lanes fully passed, retain only fixed diagnostic rule IDs, whitelisted error codes, byte count and SHA256 of the exact UTF-8 public PDF error. Inspect at most16384 characters; no raw text, paths, URLs, stack or arbitrary metadata. This observes signals, not a proven cause.
Keep all qualification assertions and hosted/browser boundaries unchanged; do not set MCP_CLIENT_DOCKER, add no-sandbox flags, change stderr handling or weaken any gate.

Normally integrate independently reviewed and merged descriptor main499255ad, preserving its140 verified blobs and unchanged runtime contract. Publication has real parents92f5579b and499255ad; local synthetic checkpoint history is not published.
